jobs.occupation: Administrative Assistant - Real Estate - Full Time or 4/5th
jobs.description:
As Administrative Assistant, you will provide operational and administrative support to the Estates team. The position would suit someone who genuinely enjoys administrative coordination, document follow-up and contract management, and who is comfortable working in a dynamic environment. You are fluent in French, Dutch and English. The position is possible in 4/5th of Full Time.

 

Client Details

Our client is a well-established international company managing an extensive real estate portfolio across Belgium.The company offers a stable environment, a collaborative culture and the opportunity to contribute to projects that have a tangible impact across the country. They are located in Diegem and easily accessible by car, tram, bus and train.

 

Description

• Support administration and follow-up of lease renewals, acquisitions and ongoing property files.
• Review contracts, interpret and gather relevant information.
• Manage correspondence and DocuSign signature processes.
• Ensure accurate filing and document management.
• Follow up with landlords regarding contractual and administrative matters.
• Support invoice processing and administrative reporting.
• Prepare reports, presentations and meeting documentation.
• Coordinate with various internal stakeholders and ensure proper follow-up of actions.

• A few years of experience in an administrative, coordination or property-related support role.
• Exposure to property management, lease administration, real estate, notary or similar environments is a strong asset.
• Proactive; organised and adaptable personality, able to support different stakeholders and managers.
• Professional level French and Dutch, with a good level of English.

Our client is an international organization based in Zaventem, supporting operations across Europe in sectors such as automotive, industrial, energy, and materials.
 

As a Finance & Accounting Specialist, you will support day-to-day accounting activities, month-end closings, reporting processes, audits, and continuous improvement initiatives while working closely with colleagues across the business.
 

Your Responsibilities
 

Sales & Purchase Accounting
 

 
• Support the Sales Department with accounting treatment, SAP bookings, and invoice reviews.
 
• Review outgoing invoices and maintain accounting procedures and manuals.
 
• Expenses & Invoice Management
 
• Process expense invoices and bank transactions in SAP.
 
• Support internal users with SAP and invoice-related queries.
 
• Review and process employee expense claims via SAP Concur.
 
• Keep procedures up to date and contribute to process improvements and Kaizen initiatives. 
 

General Accounting Support
 

 
• Assist with monthly closings and reporting.
 
• Perform reconciliations, bank postings, account reviews, and follow-up on open items.
 
• Support invoice booking and resolve accounting discrepancies.
 
• Prepare documentation for audits 
 
• Provide backup support for payments, banking, foreign exchange, and other finance-related activities.
 
• Support the Accounting Manager with accruals,  

Your Profile
 

 
• Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field.
 
• Approximately 2 to 3 years of relevant accounting experience.
 
• Solid understanding of accounting principles and financial processes.
 
• Experience working with SAP is a strong asset.
 
• Comfortable working with Microsoft Office, especially Excel.
 
• Strong attention to detail and high level of accuracy.
 
• Proactive, solution-oriented mindset with a continuous improvement attitude.
 
• Able to work independently while being a strong team player.
 
• Excellent communication skills and stakeholder management abilities.
 
• Fluent in English, with a good knowledge of Dutch and French.

jobs.occupation: S/4HANA Implementation Support Specialist - Drive digital transformation in a cloud environment
jobs.description:
Ready to use your SAP expertise in a project that makes a real impact? This is your opportunity to play a key role in a major digital transformation within an international organization that is investing heavily in innovation, technology, and process optimization.

For a leading company active in the housing and real estate sector, we are looking for a temporary reinforcement to support the implementation of SAP S/4HANA Cloud. You will join a forward-thinking environment where your contribution will directly influence the success of an important digitalization project.

Your responsibilities

As an S/4HANA Implementation Support Specialist, you will help ensure a smooth and successful implementation process by:

• Supporting the rollout of SAP S/4HANA Cloud across the organization

• Assisting in the optimization and digitalization of business processes

• Providing support to end users and answering system-related questions

• Executing test scenarios and documenting findings

• Analyzing workflows and identifying opportunities for improvement

• Collaborating with internal stakeholders and external partners

• Creating and maintaining process documentation and user guidelines

• Contributing to a seamless transition toward the new ERP environment

In short, this is a varied position where you can make a tangible contribution to a high-impact transformation project.

We are seeking a proactive professional who can quickly adapt to a dynamic project environment and enjoys improving processes.

• Hands-on experience with SAP S/4HANA is essential

• Familiarity with cloud-based ERP systems

• Fluent communication skills in English

• Previous experience in ERP implementation, digital transformation, or system migration projects

• Strong analytical and problem-solving mindset

• Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail

• Ability to work independently while maintaining strong collaboration with colleagues

• An understanding of business processes in sales, operations, or administration is a plus

You do not need to know everything already, but a solid SAP foundation and a willingness to learn are key to succeeding in this role.

Tasks:

Teach task-based language classes. Adapt the classes to the future professions and the language levels of the students. Integrate role plays and simulations of language situations.

 
Requirements:

• Excellent command of English (C2 level or equivalent) 
• Experience teaching English to non-native speakers
• Pedagogical, linguistic, literary or artistic background 
We're offering:

	
• One-on-one classes as well as group classes
	
• Different locations among which Rue du Grand Hospice 7, 1000 Brussels
	
• Contractual or self-employed
	
• Good hourly rates

Our aim is to offer participants:
• A solid understanding of the fundamentals of cybersecurity
• Technical skills sought after by companies
• Personalised support towards employment
• Up to 2 permanent positions
• A strong professional network built through mentoring and workshops
The course is designed to enable participants to develop their skills gradually, and is structured around 14 technical modules. It is aimed at motivated beginners and does not require any prior IT training; participants simply need to have a good working knowledge of digital tools and a high motivation to learn. Ten women will be selected to take part in the course.

In addition to technical skills, we place particular emphasis on personal development and professional preparation. We therefore focus on building self-confidence, developing soft skills, and actively preparing students for entry into the job market.
Following the six-month training programme, participants will undertake a two-month work placement to gain experience in the workplace. Half of the participants (5) will be selected by the company
The main focus areas of the course:
• The basics of cybersecurity
• Network and cloud security
• Systems and application security
• Administration and security operations
• Incident response and crisis management
• Advanced technical cybersecurity
• Compliance and regulation
• Introduction to Cryptography
• Project management in cybersecurityEach module combines:
• Interactive theory lessons led by experts
• Practical exercises and group workshops
• Incident simulations and role-play exercises
• Case studies drawn from real-world experiences
This approach promotes a realistic work environment and helps students gain confidence quickly, paving the way for a successful transition into the professional world.
A cross-disciplinary module on coaching and support for employment is entirely dedicated to:
• Active job-seeking preparation (CVs, cover letters, AI tools, mock interviews, etc.)
• Individual coaching and group coaching
• Meetings with industry professionals
• Workshops on positioning yourself in the job market
• Practical networking with partner companies Conditions of participation
• Be registered as a jobseeker or looking to change career;
• Hold a GHSO (CESS);
• Have a basic understanding of IT tools and the internet or motivation to learn;
• Fluency in Dutch; good written and spoken English (Level C); knowledge of French is an advantage;
• Have a keen interest in new technologies;
• Be available full-time for 8 months starting from 12 october;
• Be curious, motivated and ready to take on a new professional challenge! By the end of the training, participants :
• will have a solid foundation: a thorough understanding of fundamental concepts, cryptography and key standards (including the NIS 2 Directive).
• will be responsible for operational security: developing and implementing security policies, and managing access and vulnerabilities.
• will be proficient in infrastructure security: securing networks, the cloud, operating systems and applications.
• will be proficient in risk analysis and management: the ability to identify, assess and manage security risks.
• will be able to respond to incidents: detecting, responding to and resolving threats.
• will possess a range of transferable skills: critical thinking, the ability to communicate results clearly, project management and an awareness of safety culture.
Following the training and work placement, up to two participants will be hired as junior security engineer/administrator on permanent contracts by our partner, Axians!

This course is more than just training: it's a catalyst for life-changing transformation. Join a community of determined women who are being trained and supported to take their place in a sector with a bright future.

As an operator, you work with the team to produce and process corrugated cardboard. You set up the machines, monitor the process, and check the quality. You solve small malfunctions yourself; for bigger issues, you can turn to the team leader. You work in an orderly, accurate, and independent way. Apply quickly if you like working in 2 shifts!

You speak fluent Dutch and/or English
You enjoy working independently and can operate a machine
You are accurate, tidy, and have an eye for detail
You are a true team player and eager to learn
You have a technical interest or experience (plus)
You have a diploma in lower or higher secondary education (BSO, TSO)
Experience is not required but is a plus
You have a correct and hardworking attitude

As a welder, you are responsible for manual and semi-automatic welding of different parts. You work precisely and have an eye for quality, because your workmanship directly impacts the final product.

A typical day involves reading technical plans, preparing materials, and handling welding tasks according to given specifications. You assemble the welded components into a solid, durable end product. You work independently, but can also cooperate with other skilled workers when needed.

Are you handy, detail-oriented, and do you take pride in a perfectly finished product? Then this job is for you. Apply now and show your skills!

• You have a technical background or proven welding experience.

• You can read and accurately follow technical plans.

• You are physically fit and enjoy hands-on work.

• You like working independently and pay attention to detail.

• You speak, write, and understand English.

In this role you support big clients in improving the way they plan, monitor and manage complex technical projects. You work on project controls topics such as scheduling, progress tracking, reporting, forecasting, risk follow-up and performance insights.
You help structure project data, improve processes and support the implementation or optimization of project management tools. You do not need to know all tools from day one: the company provides strong internal training and guidance.
You work closely with project teams, consultants and client stakeholders to translate project information into clear insights and actionable improvements. Depending on the project, you may also contribute to dashboards, BI reporting and data-driven decision-making. This is a role for someone who combines an interest in technical projects with the ability to understand digital tools and process optimization.

• Knowledge of Project Controls
• You combine analytical thinking with strong communication skills
• You are OK with working very independently after training/onboarding
• You are fluent in English (additional languages such as Dutch or French are a plus)
